subject: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Whitney Lane <whitney.lane@novahealth.com>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth

Hi Whitney —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. As discussed, we'll start the Archer portal onboarding and scope the evidence we need to populate NovaHealth's profile. Two specific asks from our side to make the first upload cleaner:

1) Role-access matrix — who on your side needs edit access vs reviewer only for Archer? If you can provide a CSV with columns (name, email, role, expiry) we'll pre-seed accounts.

2) Evidence rotation window — you mentioned a quarterly cadence. We propose a 90-day TTL for high-risk artifacts (SOC2 reports, penetration test summaries) and 180 days for lower-risk snapshots (architecture diagrams, configurations). We'll document this in the portal and wire up reminders.

I attached a short onboarding form to capture the above plus contact for procurement. If you prefer, we can set up an SFTP/API handoff for bulk evidence instead of manual uploads.

Next steps: if you can return the onboarding form and role_access_matrix_draft.csv by EOD Thursday, we will:
- Create initial Archer accounts and SSO mapping
- Upload SOC2/pen test files to a staging folder
- Link DocuSign for the portal access agreement (if needed)

Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan from GTM on timing for contract/credits.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- NovaHealth_Archer_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
- role_access_matrix_draft.csv (text/csv)

From: Whitney Lane <whitney.lane@novahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@novahealth.com, security@novahealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers inline: 

- Role access: I attached a completed matrix (columns match your template). Primary editors: myself and Kenji Watanabe (secops lead). Reviewers: procurement and compliance.
- Evidence TTL: 90/180 cadence works for us; can you add a flag for any evidence that should be "permanent" (do not auto-rotate)? We have legal docs that must be retained permanently.

We prefer API transfer over SFTP if you support it — our security team wants encrypted object upload (SSE + TLS).

Also attaching the initial vendor security questionnaire (our side) — we'll need Redwood's SOC2 artifact uploaded to the portal. Procurement also asked whether you support DocuSign for the access agreement.

I'll upload the files to the temporary S3 bucket you gave us on the call unless you confirm API is live.

Best,
Whitney Lane
Head of Vendor Risk, NovaHealth

Attachments:
- novahealth_role_access_completed.csv (text/csv)
- novahealth_vendor_q_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth

Team — forwarding Whitney's completed matrix and their PQ. Action items: 

- Mina: please pull SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf and the latest penetration test summary and upload to the Archer staging folder. Mark any documents as "permanent" where legal is required.
- Evelyn: confirm Archer API upload is enabled for the NovaHealth tenant and share the API key/endpoint (we'll exchange via the vault). If API not ready, we'll provision an SFTP w/ restricted keys.
- Monica: coordinate DocuSign link creation for the portal access agreement and confirm whether procurement needs PO before activation. Jordan, please keep procurement thread warm.

I'll set internal target: staging completed by Thursday 09/16 17:00 PT.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth

Markus / team — quick update from my side: I pulled the SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf and a redacted pen-test summary. I marked both as IMPORTANT/permanent in the staging folder per Whitney's note.

Evelyn — Archer API looks like it's enabled but the NovaHealth tenant isn't added to our allowlist yet. I tested a PUT to the sandbox endpoint and received 403. Can you add novahealth@tenant.nova to the allowlist? Once that's done I'll kick the API transfer (expected 12–18 minutes for ~30MB).

Also attached a short checklist I used for this tenant: role mapping complete, legal flags set, TTLs set to 90/180. I added one nuance: NovaHealth requires hashed filenames and manifest verification; I'll include a manifest.json alongside uploads.

Attachments:
- manifest_sample.json (application/json)
- SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Mina
Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Whitney Lane <whitney.lane@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: role-access matrix + evidence rotation plan for NovaHealth

Hi all — allowlist updated and API key provisioned. 

Whitney — you should have an invite to the Archer tenant now and a temporary API key (shared via our secrets vault link below). We'll rotate the key in 7 days after you confirm ingestion success. API accepts TLS+SSE uploads and supports manifest verification.

Status summary: 
- Accounts: editors and reviewers created (Whitney, Kenji, procurement aliases) — check your inbox for invites.
- Evidence staging: SOC2 + pen-test uploaded as permanent artifacts.
- TTLs: 90/180 applied. We added the "do_not_rotate" flag on legal docs.
- DocuSign: Monica will send the portal access agreement shortly.

Next: Whitney to confirm she sees the artifacts and to sign the access agreement. After signature we'll flip the tenant from staging->live.

Secrets vault link: https://vault.redwood.internal/secrets/archer/novahealth/api-key-789

Evelyn Hart
Cloud Operations, Redwood Inference
